note: Walker County AL parcels are published only through the Flagship GIS proprietary public viewer (walker.alabamagis.com, fgis-map-102.flagshipcloud.com). Its ArcGIS-style REST endpoints return HTTP 500 and no parcel query endpoint is public. The NSGIC 2025 portal lists Walker's viewer URL with no REST API or download URL. The Alabama_Parcel_Data aggregate (services6) has no Walker layer. The Regrid nationwide MapServer returns 404 on query and is an aggregator, not the county source. No county-hosted parcel service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web search.
